description: This Java test class verifies the default header settings applied by the MessageCommandAckRequestSetter component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses parameterized tests to check combinations of timeout, response-required, and requested-acks headers in message commands.

classes.name: MessageCommandAckRequestSetterDefaultHeaderTest
classes.description: Parameterized JUnit test class that ensures default headers are correctly set or rejected for message commands.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Generates a list of parameter combinations for testing various header scenarios.

methods.name: willNeverGenerateInvalidHeadersFromValidHeaders
methods.description: Test to verify that valid input headers produce valid output headers, ensuring header integrity.

methods.name: getMessageCommand
methods.description: Creates a MessageCommand with headers set according to the test parameters.
